review.assumptionsToDischarge: Every nonzero coefficient x of an actual regular differential x D(j) on the original complex Gamma1 integral-ratio field has a native holomorphic weight-two realization with the exact modular quotient identity and Gamma covariance. No analytic realization, local place, normalization factor, finite-point regularity, local ramification bound or removable-singularity certificate remains assumed. Translation membership and finite index are source group conditions, automatic for Gamma1 at nonzero level.
review.remaining: All-cusp vanishing and exact differential Fourier matching remain before the complete regular-differential-to-cusp converse. Coefficient-field transport, actual Picard/H1, full/parabolic, transpose and diamond comparison, original finite character arithmetic realization, original all-weight association, local/image/regularity, arithmetic automorphy and literal higher symmetric-power continuation remain. The full goal and all twenty acceptance gates are unchanged; 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
review.shorterRouteReview: Use the proved actual Gamma1 modular quotient, native analytic identity theorem, existing normalized order-map-to-place theorem and existing exact local derivative order. At an actual complex point, regularity gives ord(x)>=1-ord(j-j(tau)); multiplying by the positive analytic ramification and the exact derivative order gives ord(x*j-prime)>=e-1>=0. This proves finite holomorphy without constructing a global finite-place dictionary or proving a global Gamma1 ramification profile. Cusp decay still needs a corresponding actual slash-expansion order argument. The existing Gamma0 analytic proof supplies the local pattern; no Gamma0-specific place or bound is assumed for Gamma1.
